title: Acquirer: Melbourne Business School Limited; Target: Mt Eliza Business School

body_sections.Summary: Melbourne Business School Ltd proposes to acquire Mt Eliza Business School.
body_sections.Market definition: The following two markets were considered to be relevant: 1. a market in Victoria for the supply of Post-graudate management education programs with a submarket for the supply of MBA programs; and 2. a market in Victoria for the supply of Executive Education program.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission's Merger Guidelines market thresholds are not exceeded in the relevant markets.
